title: At the bank
instructions: Diego banka hesabı açmak istiyor. Gerekli belgeler ve kart hakkındaki bilgilere dikkat et.

script.speaker: diego
script.text: Good morning. I'd like to open a bank account, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Of course. Are you a student or do you work?

script.speaker: diego
script.text: I'm a student. I came here from Mexico two months ago.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: OK, then you can open a student account. There's no monthly fee.

script.speaker: diego
script.text: Great. What do you need from me?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Your passport and a letter from your university with your address.

script.speaker: diego
script.text: I have my passport, but I don't have the letter with me.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No problem. You can bring it tomorrow. We open at nine.

script.speaker: diego
script.text: And when will I get my bank card?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It'll arrive by post in about a week.

questions.feedback: Diego iki ay önce Meksika'dan geldi.
questions.evidence: I came here from Mexico two months ago.
